Private Function Seen(t As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    s = t.Name & " " & t.Index & " " & t.ChartType & " " & t.HasLegend & " " & t.HasTitle & " " & t.SeriesCollection.Count
    For i = 1 To t.SeriesCollection.Count
        s = s & " " & t.SeriesCollection(i).Formula
    Next
    If Err.Number Then s = s & " E" & Err.Number
    Seen = s
End Function

Private Function Tabs(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim o As Object, s As String
    For Each o In wb.Sheets
        s = s & "[" & o.Name & ":" & TypeName(o) & "]"
    Next
    Tabs = s & " " & wb.ActiveSheet.Name
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String, ByVal plotted As String, ByVal selected As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, t As Object, u As Object, r As Variant, c As Object
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    ws.Range("E10").Select
    Set c = wb.Charts.Add
    c.Name = "Mine"
    Select Case plotted
    Case "0"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3")
    Case "1"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3")
    Case "2"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"), xlColumns
    Case "3"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"), xlColumns
    Case "4"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"), xlRows
    Case "5"
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("B1:C3")
    End Select
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range(selected).Select
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets("One")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 1
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 2
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)
    Case 3
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 4
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 5
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 6
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine"), Count:=2): r = Seen(t) & " / " & Seen(wb.Charts(2))
    Case 7
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets("One")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 8
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 9
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 10
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 11
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 12
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 13
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Count:=2): r = Seen(t) & " / " & Seen(wb.Charts(2))
    Case 14
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: wb.Charts("Mine").SeriesCollection(1).Delete: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)
    Case 15
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: ws.Rows(1).Insert: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 16
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)
    Case 17
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(After:=ws): r = Seen(t)
    Case 18
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): Set u = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(u)
    Case 19
        ws.Rows(1).Insert: wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 20
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: ws.Columns(1).Insert: wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    Case 21
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: ws.Rows(1).Insert: wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)
    Case 22
        wb.Charts("Mine").Activate: ws.Activate: ws.Columns(1).Insert: Set t = wb.Charts.Add(Before:=wb.Charts("Mine")): r = Seen(t)
    End Select
    Probe = "ok |" & r & "|" & Tabs(wb)
    GoTo Done
Failed:
    Probe = "Err " & Err.Number & "|" & Tabs(wb)
    Resume Done
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Function
